Subject: Re: problem with alias talbes

muzr@toodle.gr wrote:
> Hello all,
>
>
> I have setup postfix with virtual domains support and it seems to works one way, that means i can send an email from my account y.selbaxdqxmf@domain.gr properly but when it comes to receive an email i get the following error. For 5 hours now i can't firgure out why and im going crazy. Postfix runs on a production server :(
>
> my main.cf 
>   

next time, post the output of 'postconf -n' instead of main.cf.

> soft_bounce = yes
>
> queue_directory = /var/spool/postfix
>
> command_directory = /usr/sbin
>
> daemon_directory = /usr/libexec/postfix
>
> mail_owner = postfix
> myhostname = nd227
>   

please specify an fqdn hostname here. for example
myhostname = nd227.domain.gr

> mydomain = domain.gr
>
> myorigin = $mydomain
> inet_interfaces = all
> local_recipient_maps = unix:passwd.byname $alias_maps $virtual_alias_maps
>   
remove $virtual_alias_maps from here. virtual_alias_maps are always used.
> unknown_local_recipient_reject_code = 450
>
> mynetworks_style = class
> mynetworks = 192.168.0.0/24 168.254.0.0/28, 127.0.0.0/8, 10.10.0.0/24,
> relay_domains = $mydestination  $mynetworks 
>   
remove this setting. relay_domains is the list of domains you relay to.
> [snip]
> #ClamAV
> content_filter = scan:[127.0.0.1]:10025
> transport = virtual
>   
what's this?

> virtual_alias_maps = hash:/etc/postfix/virtual_alias_maps
>
> my virtual_alias_maps
>
> rrayrn@domain.gr domain.gr
>   
what's this for?
> domain.gr domain.gr
>   
and this? you don't alias a domain to itself.
> y.selbaxdqxmf@domain.gr a.faragitakis
>   

since myorigin=$mydomain, this simply says:

y.selbaxdqxmf@domain.gr a.faragitakis@domain.gr

but postfix has no idea how to deliver to a.faragitakis@domain.gr. 

Thus the error:
> [snip]
> Feb 14 14:18:29 nd227 postfix/error[11511]: 1DCA795C017:
> to=, relay=none, delay=0, status=SOFTBOUNCE
> (User unknown in virtual alias table)
>   

here is some reading:

http://www.postfix.org/BASIC_CONFIGURATION_README.html
http://www.postfix.org/STANDARD_CONFIGURATION_README.html
http://www.postfix.org/VIRTUAL_README.html
http://www.postfix.org/ADDRESS_CLASS_README.html
